experiment: E090 hand classification of E083 aviation maintenance fault code search results
rubric: served = working solution/direct link/step-by-step guide; partially_served = relevant info (definition, manufacturer notes) but no complete guide; unserved = no relevant results or only irrelevant results. Keywords: SOLUTION_KEYWORDS={how to,tutorial,guide,solution,fix,repair,tool,software,app,download,install,step by step,method,procedure,resolution,fix for,fixes,troubleshooting}; INFO_KEYWORDS={definition,what is,overview,introduction,summary,characteristics,fault code,meaning,indicates,refers to}. Subject mention: any retrieved text mentioning the query's distinctive subject term (excluding chrome words).
classifier_version: hand-classification by author using rubric written before viewing results

g1_discrimination.description: Known-unserved false positive rate <= 0.30 with Newcombe CI95 lower bound > 0
g1_discrimination.result: FAIL — false positive rate 0.80 exceeds 0.30 threshold; CI95 [0.376, 0.964] spans 0.30

key_finding: The classify_served instrument (Bing search + solution-keyword rubric) produces 4/5 false positives on known-unserved needs in aviation maintenance fault-code domain. Hand classification yields 19/30 served by rubric but only 17/19 actually mention the query subject. Newcombe CI95 for false positive rate [0.376, 0.964] includes values above the 0.30 kill gate threshold, so the gate cannot pass. The instrument is fundamentally inadequate for discrimination on this domain.
discrimination_test_status: FAILED — instrument cannot reliably separate served from unserved needs at required thresholds
labels_known_by_construction: Hand-classified ground truth: 19 served, 3 partially_served, 8 unserved across 30 aviation maintenance fault code search results. These labels are 'known by construction' per STATE.md §265.
